Excited to announce that our SRM alumni mentorship program has crossed 1,000 sessions this year! 🎉

If you're a current SRM student looking for guidance on tech careers, product management, or cloud engineering — my calendar is open. Let's build the next generation of SRM leaders together.

#SRMConnect #AlumniMentorship #GiveBack

GreenDrive just delivered our 10,000th electric scooter! 🛵⚡

From a dorm room idea at SRM to a team of 200 — this journey has been incredible. Grateful to every professor who believed in us and every alumni who opened doors.

We're hiring 15 engineers. DM me if you're passionate about sustainable mobility.
What's the most valuable skill you learned at SRM that still helps you today?

Our latest paper on Indian population genomics was published in Nature Genetics! 📄

This research builds on work I started during my final year project at SRM under Dr. Rajesh Kumar's guidance. Never underestimate the impact of undergraduate research.

Link in comments for interested biotech students.

Just completed my first mentorship session with Arjun Krishnamurthy sir through SRM Connect! 🙏

Got incredible insights on system design interviews and career planning. This platform is a game-changer for students. Already booked my next session.

Thank you SRM Alumni Nexus!

Hosting an AMA (Ask Me Anything) for SRM students this Friday at 7 PM IST!

Topics: Working abroad, Amazon interview prep, open source contributions, and life as an NRI alumni.

Register through the Events section. See you there! 👋
